messages:
Maya H: Quick sync after the postmortem - we need a QA bakeoff that covers the recurring memory pressure/regression pattern. looking for owners for promptsets, infra stress tests, and the canary gate.
Carlos G: I'm happy to lead the infra stress/load side. propose two tiers: smoke load (small bursts) and heavy soak (30m).
Nina T: I'll take promptsets. plan: extract 50 representative failed sessions from the incident timeline and turn them into a deterministic prompt bundle. ETA 4 days.
Omar V: question: do we keep promptsets in evals repo or store them in S3 with a manifest? we should be able to pin them in CI.
Maya H: prefer repo + manifest JSON so CI can checkout by tag. include incident id and expected output signatures.
qa-bot: New postmortem-linked issue created: https://gh.redwood/infra/pm-567-regression-bakeoff (auto-created)
Carlos G: For load tests: define profiles: burst_95_60s, tail_burst_10m, steady_soak_30m. I'll add configs to k6 and to our workload simulator.
Nina T: promptset naming: mempress/rep-sessions-v1, mempress/long-streams-v1. I'll add metadata: description, source-trace, owner, pinned-ci-tag.
Omar V: CI gating idea: a lightweight smoke job on every canary, full regression on nightly and on deploy-to-prod. smoke job should run on cpu runners only.
Maya H: agree. add a pre-release check: `ci/evals/smoke-mempress` that must pass before any canary is promoted.
Carlos G: minimal CI snippet below (different format than usual):
```
name: mempress-regression
on: [push, schedule]
schedule:
  - cron: '0 6 * * *'
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./tools/run_eval.sh --suite smoke --tag ${GIT_TAG}
  full:
    runs-on: [ubuntu-gpu]
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule'
    steps:
      - run: ./tools/run_eval.sh --suite full --timeout 3600
```
Nina T: I'll also add a small seed-based randomizer so promptsets are deterministic but can simulate minor perturbations.
Maya H: Ownership summary and deadlines:
 - Nina T: prepare prompt bundles v1 (ETA 2025-03-09)
 - Carlos G: add load profiles to workload repo + k6 scripts (ETA 2025-03-07)
 - Omar V: add CI jobs + gating config (ETA 2025-03-10)
 - Maya H: publish bakeoff runbook and acceptance criteria (ETA 2025-03-08)
Maya H: also scheduling a dry-run chaos drill focused on cache warm/cold and aggressive small-requests fanout. drill date: 2025-03-15. prep meeting 2025-03-11. volunteers?
Carlos G: I'll handle the infra scenario and monitor kv-cache metrics.
Nina T: I'll be the test owner during the drill and will run prompt bundles.
Omar V: I'll wire up the CI gating so drill artifacts are archived and linked to the GH issue.
Maya H: please add explicit rollback criteria to the runbook: if token-error-rate > 0.5% AND 99th-latency > 2s sustained for 3 min -> rollback. if partial degradation, flip to degrade-mode (reduced concurrency) and alert SRE.
qa-bot: Reminder: schedule the focused drill: 2025-03-15 16:00 UTC.
Maya H: I'll create sub-tasks in the GH issue and ping owners. escalate here if any ETA slips more than 48h. thanks all.
Carlos G: ack, starting work on k6 profiles.
Nina T: ack, extracting traces now.
Omar V: ack, will draft CI PR early next week.
